channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-amazon-seller
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Trends MCP — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: MCP server and REST API with trend data from Amazon, Google Search, Google Shopping, TikTok, YouTube and other sources, for demand research in an AI assistant. Free plan with 100 requests a month. GitHub

item.title: TranslateMyImage — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Translates the text inside product images, infographics, A+ modules and size charts into other languages, and keeps the original layout. Works from the final JPG or PNG files. Three free test images.

item.title: Threecolts Seller 365 — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: One subscription for ten Amazon seller tools: sourcing, listing, repricing, feedback requests and profit tracking. Includes the former FeedbackWhiz.

item.title: PixVibe — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Browser-based background remover that exports product photos on a white or transparent background, with tools to compress, resize and crop images. Free for single images, with no account.

item.title: Perpetua — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Marketplace advertising strategy and Amazon PPC guides. Formerly the Sellics blog.

item.title: Perpetua — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Advertising software and managed services for Amazon, Instacart and other marketplaces, plus Amazon DSP and Google Ads. Formerly Sellics.

item.title: Inventory Optimizer — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Demand forecasting and restock planning for Amazon FBA, AWD and FBM, Shopify and QuickBooks. Formerly ForecastRx.

item.title: Fbaleaks — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Audits FBA inventory and reimbursement reports in the browser. Finds lost or damaged units that Amazon did not reimburse, sorts SKUs to keep, reprice or remove, and drafts appeal letters. Free tools and a one-time paid audit.

item.title: CorpusIQ — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Connects ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity read-only to Amazon Seller, Shopify, GA4, QuickBooks and 40+ other systems, and answers questions about the business with the source of each number. From $29.95 a month, with a 30-day free trial.

item.title: ChannelX — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: News, articles and events for businesses that sell on online marketplaces. Formerly Tamebay.

item.title: BulkBarcode Generator — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Makes FNSKU, UPC, EAN-13, Code 128 and QR labels in bulk from an Excel or CSV file, and exports print-ready PDF rolls for thermal printers. Runs in the browser. Free plan.

item.title: Awesome Agentic Commerce — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Curated list of agentic commerce resources: protocols (ACP, UCP, MCP), agent-readiness tools, and guides to make products visible to AI shopping agents.

item.title: Off Hours — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Amazon Ads scheduling and automation for Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts in all marketplaces across the North America, Europe and Far East regions. Runs dayparting, budget, event, performance and bid-adjustment rules on schedules and conditions the seller defines, checked every 15 minutes. Flat $149 per month per Amazon Ads account, never a percentage of ad spend. 14-day free trial.

item.title: Firecrawl — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Web scraping and search API for Amazon data. Scrape public Amazon pages as markdown (tested on Amazon.com, Amazon.co.uk and Amazon.de), or use structured data providers for Amazon.com (product details, prices, buy-box offers, reviews, search), Amazon.com.br and Amazon.nl.

item.title: Vendooly — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: MCP connector that brings Seller Central and Amazon Ads into ChatGPT and Claude through the official Amazon APIs. The AI prepares each change with a before/after preview and it runs only after your approval. 14-day free trial.

item.title: VNCNT Labs Keyword Research — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Reverse ASIN (the Amazon keywords any ASIN ranks for) and keyword ideas from a seed via Amazon related searches and Google autocomplete, with search volume, CPC, difficulty and a USPTO trademark flag. Runs on Apify, pay per result from $0.002 per keyword, no subscription.

item.title: Utlista — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Localises an existing product catalogue into Amazon listings for seven EU marketplaces (de, fr, it, es, nl, pl, se). Writes title, five bullets, description and backend search terms per destination marketplace rather than translating them, and validates every field against Amazon's limits before export, including search terms counted in bytes. Produces a flat file per marketplace; it does not upload to Amazon. Free for ten products.

item.title: ScrapeUnblocker — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Web scraping API with Amazon endpoints that return JSON: product pages (price, list price, availability, rating, seller, images), search results with sponsored and Prime flags, Best Sellers and other ranked lists, and review data with the star histogram, across Amazon's regional marketplaces. Also available as an MCP server.

item.title: RefVid — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: AI product video generator that keeps label, logo and packaging consistent across clips, from 1-5 photos or an Amazon product link. Free credits on sign-up.

item.title: ChineseCheck — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Verify a Chinese supplier before paying: look up the company by English name, Chinese name or Unified Social Credit Code and read its registration record in English for free; paid reports add court enforcement, litigation and penalty records.

item.title: zonfy Free Seller Tools — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Free, no-signup browser tools for Amazon listings: main image compliance checker (white background, fill, resolution), image fixer, A+ Content module size tool, title and listing analyzer, backend search terms byte counter, Brand Registry eligibility checker, and a US/India profit calculator. Paid AI A+ Content and listing generator.

item.title: ZonRival — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Amazon competitor research inside Claude and ChatGPT via MCP: review complaint topics from Amazon's "Customers say" summaries, 90-day price and rank history, listing audits, keyword rankings with advertisers, and daily competitor alerts. Free review complaint checker, no sign-up.

item.title: Vendlen — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Amazon Ads analytics and automation for sellers on the US marketplace. Each recommendation shows the evidence, period and scope behind it; automation rules run inside limits you set and can be previewed before they change anything. 14-day free trial.

item.title: Listimo — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: AI listing checker (score 0-100) and generator for Amazon titles, bullet points, A+ content, listing images and video from one product photo. Free daily check without signup; credits instead of a subscription.

item.title: B2B Supplier Hub — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Supplier discovery for Amazon wholesale sellers and resellers. Search by brand, product or UPC to see which distributors carry an item, wholesale cost ranges, stock levels and last-updated dates; pay only to reveal a distributor. Chrome extension shows distributors behind Amazon listings. Free plan.

item.title: Sellantica — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Amazon PPC automation for sellers and agencies: one-click campaign structures, keyword harvesting from auto campaigns, bid optimization with explainable reasoning, and per-product P&L. EU-hosted.

item.title: Ryndix Amazon category data — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Free CC BY 4.0 dataset of Amazon US category snapshots: units, price bands, review distribution, cost per click, fee load and pre-advertising unit economics for five categories.

item.title: AdsTurbo — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: AI video ad generator: turn an Amazon product link into short video ads with AI UGC actors, translate into 35+ languages. Free plan.

item.title: ListCraft HQ — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Free, no-signup suite of calculators for sellers covering profit margin, markup, break-even, ROAS, CAC, and LTV. No login or paywall.

item.title: Pangolinfo — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: MCP server and REST API exposing 19 read-only Amazon data tools: product details, reviews, keyword search, category and niche analysis, Best Sellers, New Releases, and seller storefronts, plus WIPO trademark and US PACER patent litigation lookups. Connects over Streamable HTTP; Python client available via pip install pangolinfo-mcp.

item.title: Seller Calculators — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Free Amazon fee and profit margin decision tools for multi-channel sellers.

item.title: ListingPic — via awesome-amazon-seller
item.description: Free browser-based tool for checking Amazon product images and marketplace listing thumbnails before publishing.
